label: От
description: The preposition от ('from/away from') + genitive: motion away, source/sender, and cause.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion away from a point. 'Отойди' commands stepping back, and 'от двери' takes the genitive (дверь) to mark the spot left behind. От signals moving away from an object's vicinity.
Strategic focus: Moving away from a spot. 'Отошёл' is past motion, and 'от окна' is genitive (окно), the starting point of the walk. От signals departure from the vicinity of an object.
Strategic focus: Distance from a place. 'Далеко' measures remoteness, and 'от дома' takes the genitive (дом) as the reference point. От fixes the origin from which the distance is measured.

missions.phrase: Беги от опасности как можно быстрее.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Fleeing away from. 'Беги' commands running, and 'от опасности' is genitive (опасность), the thing fled. От marks separation from a source of threat.
Strategic focus: Nearness to a point. 'Недалеко' marks short distance, and 'от реки' takes the genitive (река) landmark. От anchors the measured distance to its origin.
Strategic focus: Sender of an item. 'Письмо' is the thing sent, and 'от друга' is genitive (друг), the source. От names the person the letter came from.

missions.phrase: Это подарок от мамы на праздник.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Source of a gift. 'Подарок' is the object given, and 'от мамы' takes the genitive (мама) giver. От marks the person the gift originates from.
Strategic focus: Belonging to an object. 'Ключ' is the key, and 'от двери' is genitive (дверь), what it opens. От links the key to its matching lock.
Strategic focus: Greeting from a person. 'Привет' is the message, and 'от него' is the genitive pronoun (он) source. От identifies who sends the greeting.
Strategic focus: Remedy against a thing. 'Лекарство' is the medicine, and 'от кашля' takes the genitive (кашель) ailment. От marks what the cure works against.
Strategic focus: Cause of a state. 'Устал' is the resulting tiredness, and 'от работы' is genitive (работа), the cause. От marks the reason behind the condition.
Strategic focus: Cause of a reaction. 'Дрожит' is the trembling, and 'от холода' takes the genitive (холод) cause. От links the shaking to the cold.
Strategic focus: Cause of an emotion. 'Плачет' is the crying, and 'от радости' is genitive (радость), the trigger. От marks the feeling that produces the tears.
Strategic focus: Cause of a change. 'Покраснел' is the blushing, and 'от стыда' takes the genitive (стыд) cause. От names the emotion driving the reaction.

missions.phrase: Кот спрятался ото всех под кроватью.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Fixed ото variant. 'Спрятался' is hiding, and 'ото всех' uses ото before a consonant cluster, genitive (все). От marks separation from everyone.
